column3: NKJV has “we who were Paul's companions departed,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “we departed.”
NKJV has “glorified the Lord,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “glorified God.”
NKJV includes “The assembly must certainly meet,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.
NKJV includes “that they should observe no such thing, except,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.
